description: This file defines a Python module that implements an MQTT bridge using the paho-mqtt client. It encapsulates connecting to an MQTT broker, subscribing to topics, handling incoming messages with optional hooks, and publishing messages to a specified topic. The class MQTTBridge provides high-level functions to manage MQTT communications within a Django project context.

classes.name: MQTTBridge
classes.description: A high-level class managing MQTT client setup, connection, subscription, message processing, and publishing within a Django application.

methods.name: __init__( self, on_message_hook: Optional[Callable[[mqtt.Client, mqtt.MQTTMessage], Optional[bytes]]] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the MQTTBridge with configuration from Django settings and sets up the MQTT client.

methods.name: connect(self)
methods.description: Connects to the MQTT broker and starts the network loop in a background thread.

methods.name: subscribe(self)
methods.description: Subscribes to the configured MQTT topic with specified QoS.

methods.name: publish(self, payload: bytes)
methods.description: Publishes a message payload to the designated publish topic.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Stops the MQTT network loop and disconnects the client.

methods.name: _on_connect(self, client, userdata, flags, reason_code, properties=None)
methods.description: Internal callback triggered upon MQTT connection; handles subscription upon success.

methods.name: _on_disconnect(self, client, userdata, reason_code, properties=None)
methods.description: Internal callback triggered upon MQTT disconnection.

methods.name: _on_message(self, client, userdata, message: "mqtt.MQTTMessage")
methods.description: Internal callback for processing incoming MQTT messages, optionally transforming and relaying them.
